text: English Proficiency TestSince the academic program at GTIIT is taught in English, applicants are required to demonstrate their English proficiency before they enroll. Applicants from high schools where English is not the primary language of instruction are required to submit official copies of their scores on the TOEFL, IELTS, the SAT Reasoning, or ACT Plus Writing Test.Required Scores on English Proficiency Tests Test TypeRecommended ScoreMinimum scoreTOEFL- Internet Based Test (IBT)8580IELTS6.56.0 Candidates applying from the USA or from high schools taught according to the American system, must take a standardized test (SAT or ACT) before applying. GTIIT has minimum test score requirements for the math section as detailed below.
